title: Generated supply chest — E08
attribution: Production Gothic reward chest created with Meshy; runtime processing by Samfa12/Codex.
modifications: OpenLegend closes the original generated lid, shares identical source vertices, groups existing paint into two material regions and fits the unchanged native crate envelope.

generation.sourceReview: Upstream accepted preview and neutral PBR, but rejected this remesh for its fine ornament fidelity. OpenLegend tests its broad shape at coarse gameplay sampling; it does not adopt the separately hand-reauthored runtime chest as evidence of generated geometry.
generation.accountPlanCaveat: Upstream did not independently prove the active Meshy plan and explicitly distributed this asset using the conservative Free-plan CC BY 4.0 route.

runtime.renderTreatment: Ordinary StandardMaterial colors prepared by the same ArtMaterials and ShadowMaterial owners as the authored scene. No prop-specific shader.
runtime.fitPolicy: The caller preserves each existing crate appearance envelope: 1 x 0.8 x 0.8 metres for resources and 1 x 0.55 x 0.8 metres for item piles in the verified starting scene.

reviewStatus: Prepared and application-verified comparison candidate; creator visual acceptance remains separate.
